title: Write the Assertion Suite
briefMd:
# Write the Assertion Suite

100 support-bot responses. 100 human pass/fail labels you cannot see. Write checks that agree with the humans.

You submit an **Assertion DSL** YAML suite (RE2 only). The positive class is **fail** — you are building a detector of bad outputs.

Pass when F1 ≥ 0.70, precision ≥ 0.65, and recall ≥ 0.60 on the hidden labels. A suite that flags more than 90% or fewer than 10% of items is rejected as degenerate.
